certificationCard.description: The Nonprofit Cloud Consultant certification validates your expertise in implementing Salesforce solutions for nonprofit organizations.

keyConcepts.h2: Nonprofit Cloud Consultant: Key Concepts for the Exam

blocks.heading: NPSP Core Data Model: Households and Affiliations
blocks.body: Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP) is the data model foundation for Nonprofit Cloud. The Household Account Model creates an Account for each individual Contact (their household), automatically named "[Last Name] Household." This differs from the standard B2B account model. Affiliations link Contacts to organisational Accounts (employer, chapter, board membership) — distinguishing where someone lives (Household) from where they work or serve (Organisation). The consultant configures the NPSP settings to match the nonprofit's engagement model and explains the household model to clients who are new to NPSP.

blocks.heading: Fundraising: Opportunities, Payments, and Recurring Donations
blocks.body: In NPSP, Opportunities represent donations and grants. Payment objects track actual received payments against an Opportunity — a single donation can have multiple scheduled payments. Recurring Donations create a series of Opportunities automatically on a schedule (monthly, quarterly, annual). Soft Credits allow non-donors (spouses, organisations that encouraged a gift) to receive credit for a donation without being the primary donor. The consultant configures NPSP payment settings, recurring donation schedules, and soft credit relationships to match the organisation's fundraising model.

blocks.heading: Program Management: Services and Deliveries
blocks.body: Program Management Module (PMM) tracks services delivered to beneficiaries. Key objects: Program (a service offering — food bank, job training), Program Engagement (a specific client's ongoing participation in a program), Service (a type of service — food box delivery, coaching session), Service Delivery (a specific instance of a service delivered to a client on a date). The consultant configures PMM to match the organisation's service model, sets up program-specific fields, and designs reports to measure program outcomes and client outcomes over time.

blocks.heading: Grant Management: Funds and Allocations
blocks.body: NPSP uses General Accounting Units (GAUs) to track restricted funds and allocations. A GAU represents a fund, grant, or project that donors and grantors restrict their gifts to. GAU Allocations split a donation between multiple GAUs (e.g., 60% to the education programme, 40% to general operations). The Award object (in Grants Management package) tracks grant applications, awards, and reporting requirements from funders. The consultant configures the fund management structure to support the organisation's grant reporting and restricted fund accounting needs.

blocks.heading: Reporting and Impact Measurement
blocks.body: Nonprofits need to demonstrate impact to funders and stakeholders. NPSP provides built-in reports for fundraising KPIs: donor retention rate, average gift size, year-over-year giving comparison, LYBUNT/SYBUNT analysis (Lapsed/Some Year But Unfortunately Not This year donors). Program impact reports track service delivery volume and client outcomes. CRM Analytics for Nonprofits provides pre-built dashboards for major donor portfolio analysis, campaign performance, and program impact measurement. The consultant designs the reporting strategy to support annual reports, grant reporting, and board presentations.

scenarioTips.h2: How to Pass the Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Consultant Exam
scenarioTips.intro: The Nonprofit Cloud exam tests implementation of NPSP (Nonprofit Success Pack) and Nonprofit Cloud features for mission-driven organizations. Focus on the data model differences from commercial Salesforce and the fundraising/program management features.

blocks.heading: NPSP Household Account Model
blocks.body: NPSP uses Household Accounts (one per family/household) with Contacts as household members. Understand how this differs from the standard B2B account model and implications for duplicate management and household giving.

blocks.heading: Gift Entry & Payment Processing
blocks.body: Know Nonprofit Cloud Gift Entry with its batch entry templates, gift commitments, and partial soft credits. Understand how payment processors integrate and how gift records relate to Opportunities.

blocks.heading: Relationships & Affiliations
blocks.body: NPSP Relationships track personal connections between Contacts (e.g., spouse, board member). Affiliations track organizational connections between Contacts and Accounts. Know when to use each and how reciprocal relationships work.

blocks.heading: Program Management
blocks.body: Program Management Module (PMM) tracks services, programs, service schedules, and service deliveries. Know the PMM object model and how service delivery data rolls up to program reporting.

blocks.heading: TDTM (Table-Driven Trigger Management)
blocks.body: NPSP uses TDTM to manage its trigger logic through configuration records rather than code. Understand how TDTM Handler records control trigger behavior and how to troubleshoot TDTM-related issues.

sampleQuestions.question: Which data model is recommended for tracking donations in Nonprofit Cloud?
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP provides a specialized data model for tracking donations, with features like recurring donations, soft credits, and gift entry.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the purpose of Household Accounts in NPSP?
options: To group related individual contacts into family units
sampleQuestions.explanation: Household Accounts group related individual contacts (family members) together, allowing you to track household giving and communications.

sampleQuestions.question: Which feature allows nonprofits to track in-kind donations?
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP includes In-Kind Gift fields on the Opportunity object to track non-monetary donations like goods and services.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the Engagement Plan feature used for?
options: Creating task templates for donor stewardship
sampleQuestions.explanation: Engagement Plans create templated task sequences for donor stewardship, ensuring consistent follow-up and cultivation activities.

sampleQuestions.question: How does NPSP handle recurring donations?
options: Using Recurring Donation objects with installment Opportunities
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP uses Recurring Donation objects that automatically create installment Opportunities based on the donation schedule.

sampleQuestions.question: What is a Soft Credit in NPSP?
options: Attributing a gift to a contact who influenced the donation (e.g., peer-to-peer)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Soft credits attribute influence to contacts who helped secure the gift.

sampleQuestions.question: Which NPSP feature supports tribute and memorial giving?
options: Tribute and memorial fields and related processing
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP supports tribute and memorial giving with dedicated fields.

sampleQuestions.question: What does the Affiliations object track?
options: Relationships between contacts and accounts (e.g., employment, education)

sampleQuestions.question: Which NPSP feature helps manage volunteer hours?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Volunteer Jobs and Volunteer Hours track volunteer engagement.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the purpose of Payment records in NPSP?
options: To track individual payments against an Opportunity (e.g., pledge installments)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Payment records track individual payments against Opportunities.

sampleQuestions.question: Which feature supports grant management in Nonprofit Cloud?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Grant management features support applications and reporting.

sampleQuestions.question: What does the Forecast object support in NPSP?
options: Budget and revenue forecasting for fundraising
sampleQuestions.explanation: Forecast supports budget and revenue planning for nonprofits.

sampleQuestions.question: Which reporting need is common for nonprofits?
options: Donor retention, campaign ROI, and gift summary
sampleQuestions.explanation: Nonprofits need donor retention, campaign ROI, and gift reports.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the purpose of the Primary Affiliation in NPSP?
options: To designate the primary account (e.g., employer) for a contact
sampleQuestions.explanation: Primary Affiliation designates the main account for a contact.

sampleQuestions.question: Which integration is common for Nonprofit Cloud?
options: Payment processors, fundraising platforms, and accounting
sampleQuestions.explanation: Nonprofits integrate with payment processors and fundraising tools.
